title: Primer React Tailwind API inventory
description: The inclusion boundary for the package's public API, and the source of record for which upstream Primer React exports are implemented, intentionally excluded, or not required.

upstream.description: Upstream Primer React entry points that define the candidate export surface.

included.description: Exports this package implements and must expose from its root entry point.

rootExport.description: Set to false for parts reachable only through a parent component's namespace rather than the root entry point.

excluded.description: Upstream exports this package intentionally does not implement.

replacement.description: What to use instead. Consumed by documentation and agent tooling, so it must name a supported API.

notRequired.description: Upstream implementation utilities that are not part of this package's public contract.
